description: Creates a file link, up to 8 MiB: markdown is the exact source; html is the offline editor with its source inside; txt is the document's words as plain text; page is a standalone rendered web page; docx is Word; pdf carries raster pages, searchable text and the attached source. An open editor builds Word and PDF without a tap. The receipt states what each format keeps. With a connected host the link needs its connection; without one the link is its own grant. The stored file lasts up to 24 hours within the workspace lifetime.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

format.description: markdown, html, txt, page, docx or pdf.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

review_id.description: A pending review to show in an html review page beside the original source; it is not applied or approved.
